title: Zopf (Swiss Braided Sunday Bread)
summary: A milk, butter and soured cream dough plaited into a loaf and baked to a glossy golden crust.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
egg yolk beaten with 1 tbsp milk

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the milk and soured cream and knead 5 min, then add the butter and knead 8 min more until silky.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave about 1 h until doubled.

steps.title: Braid
steps.text: Divide into 3, roll each into a 45 cm rope tapered at the ends, pinch together at the top and plait loosely, tucking both ends under.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Set on the lined tray, brush with glaze and leave uncovered 40 min until puffy. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush again and bake 30-35 min until deep golden and the centre reads 88-90 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack at least 30 min before slicing.

tips: Plait loosely; the dough needs room to rise.
Glaze twice for a deep shine.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for up to 3 days, or slice and freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
